name: figma-normalizator
description: Monorepo root for the Figma Normalizator plugin and IR schema

scripts.generate: npm run generate:types --workspace=schema && npm run generate:map --workspace=mappings && npm run bundle:token-map --workspace=mappings && npm run fixtures:update --workspace=fixtures
scripts.verify:generated: npm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- schema/src/generated mappings/src/generated fixtures/src/corpus
